title: The Middle Score
statement:
Scores arrive one at a time: `a_1, ..., a_n`. After each arrival, sort all scores received so far; the median is the middle one. When an even number of scores has arrived, take the lower of the two middle ones.

Print the sum of the medians over all `n` moments.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `a_1 ... a_n`.

## Output
Print the sum of the medians.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 16000`
- `1 <= a_i <= 10^9`
